# discord_skus (Data Source)

Lists the SKUs (premium offerings) of an application. Each subscription has two SKUs: use the one of type `subscription` for entitlements, not the `subscription_group` Discord creates with it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_skus" "app" {}

output "subscription_sku_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.discord_skus.app.skus : s.id if s.type == "subscription"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application. Defaults to the application of the bot token.

### Read-Only

- `skus` (Attributes List) SKUs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skus))

<a id="nestedatt--skus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skus`

Read-Only:

- `flags` (Number) [SKU flags](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/sku#sku-object-sku-flags) bitfield, such as whether a subscription is for servers or users.
- `id` (String) SKU ID.
- `name` (String) Customer-facing name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated from the name.
- `type` (String) SKU type: `durable`, `consumable`, `subscription`, `subscription_group`.
